reason: A local document knowledge base that imports md/txt files, indexes them with embeddings, supports hybrid retrieval and citation checks, and can inject search results into the calling agent.

summaries.zh: 用于将本地 Markdown 或纯文本文档建立为可检索知识库，并提供混合搜索、引用核验和结果注入功能。
summaries.en: Builds a local knowledge base from Markdown or text files with hybrid search, citation checking, and optional result injection into the calling agent.

capabilities: Reads user-selected md/txt files through the harness filesystem service
Stores document chunks, embeddings, and metadata in the host storage backend
Provides hybrid semantic and keyword search with optional agent-context injection
Runs an optionally configured external embedding command through a subprocess interface
